title: Asked Dain at Refugee Row to name his dead father 'gently'; the game says 'He tells you, careful, like it might break if said wrong' but never prints the name to the player. After the Long Furrow is later rested (names drawn from Ede, the parish roll, and the headland markers — all confirmed 3/3), returning to Dain and choosing 'the furrow, now it rests' has the game answer 'you don't know yet' on my behalf, even though I (the player) was never given the name to check and the quest that gathered it had already closed. Feels like the quest silently failed to connect its own two halves.
where: The Refugee Row / 'ask for his father's name, gently' and 'the furrow, now it rests'
